channel.title: CalculatedIT Threat Pulse — CISA KEV additions
channel.description: Source-traceable CISA catalog additions; not environment-specific findings.

item.title: CVE-2023-22894 — Strapi / Strapi
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-08. Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability. Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2021-3199 — ONLYOFFICE / Docs
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-08. ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability. ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2016-3081 — Apache / Struts
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-08. Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability. Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2015-5477 — ISC / BIND
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-08. ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability. ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2015-3306 — ProFTPD / ProFTPD
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-08. ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability. ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-88779 — Citrix / NetScaler
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-04. Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability. Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-102490 — Zammad GmbH / Zammad
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-02. Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability. Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-102489 — Zammad GmbH / Zammad
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-02. Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability. Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-104286 — Fortinet / FortiMail
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-01. Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability. Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-76504 — Cisco / Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-30. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-86950 — Apple / Multiple Products
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-29. Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability. Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-88772 — Citrix / NetScaler
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-27. Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability. Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-88771 — Citrix / NetScaler
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-27. Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability. Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-87902 — WordPress / Core
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-25. WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability. WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-67279 — MikroTik / RouterOS
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-25. Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability. Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-65660 — Microsoft / SharePoint
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-25. Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability. Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-71362 — Adobe / Commerce and Magento
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-24. Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability . Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-5430 — WSO2 / Multiple Products
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-24. WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability . WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-94127 — F5 / BIG-IP APM
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-22. F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability. F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-93952 — Arista / VeloCloud Orchestrator
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-22. Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability. Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-93616 — Check Point / Multiple Products
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-22. Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability. Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-85102 — Check Point / Multiple Products
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-22. Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability. Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-7273 — Zyxel / GS1900 Series Switches
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-21. Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability. Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-53266 — Linux / Kernel
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-18. Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability. Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2025-39964 — Linux / Kernel
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-18. Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability. Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2025-39682 — Linux / Kernel
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-18. Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability. Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-87886 — Acronis / Backup
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-16. Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability. Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-76460 — Cisco / Identity Services Engine
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-16. Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability. Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-58704 — Google / Pixel
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-16. Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability. Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.

item.title: CVE-2026-76461 — Cisco / Secure Email Gateway
item.description: Added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-09-14. Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability. Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system. Confirm applicability, vendor guidance, and your actual exposure.
